domain: Arithmetic with rational numbers (subtracting fractions and mixed numbers)

skills.name: Convert mixed numbers to improper fractions
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number as an equivalent improper fraction using (whole·denominator + numerator)/denominator, including cases written as whole + fraction.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly converts a mixed number a b/c into (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites a mixed number as a sum (whole + fraction) as part of converting to an improper fraction
exclusion_criteria: Only rewriting an integer as n·d/d to match a denominator (tag S03)
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction without mixed-to-improper conversion (tag S06)

skills.name: Find a common denominator and create equivalent fractions
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) for two fractions and convert one or both fractions to equivalent forms with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step states or computes an LCM/common denominator for two denominators
A step converts a fraction to an equivalent fraction with a new denominator to match a common denominator (e.g., 3/4 = 6/8)
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the step directly subtracts numerators (tag S04)
Only rewriting an integer as a fraction with a chosen denominator (tag S03)

skills.name: Rewrite whole numbers as equivalent fractions
skills.definition: Express an integer as an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator (n = n·d/d) to enable subtraction with fractions.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites an integer n as n·d/d for some denominator d
The denominator is chosen to match an existing/common denominator in the problem
exclusion_criteria: Converting a mixed number to an improper fraction (tag S01)
Finding an LCM/common denominator between fractional denominators (tag S02)

skills.name: Subtract fractions with like denominators
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two fractions that share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator (a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b), including after conversion to a common denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step performs subtraction in the form a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b
A step carries out the subtraction after earlier common-denominator conversion
exclusion_criteria: The step is primarily about finding/converting to a common denominator (tag S02)
The step is primarily about simplifying/reducing or converting the final form (tag S06)

skills.name: Subtract mixed numbers by separating whole and fractional parts
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed-number subtraction as subtraction of whole parts and fractional parts (including handling a negative fractional difference) and then recombine.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly decomposes (a b/c) − (d e/f) into (a−d) + (b/c − e/f) or an equivalent decomposition
A step recombines an integer with a (possibly negative) fraction after separate subtraction
exclusion_criteria: The method used is converting mixed numbers to improper fractions and subtracting directly (tag S01 + S04)
Only converting between improper and mixed forms without decomposition (tag S06)

skills.name: Simplify and format the result (reduce and/or convert)
skills.definition: Reduce fractions to lowest terms and/or convert between improper fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers when stating the result.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by a common factor and/or notes it is already in lowest terms (e.g., -3/12 = -1/4)
A step simplifies to a whole number (e.g., 8/8 = 1, 2/3 − 2/3 = 0) and/or converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (e.g., 22/7 = 3 1/7)
exclusion_criteria: Computing the subtraction itself without simplification/conversion (tag S04)
Converting mixed to improper as the main action (tag S01)
